text: I am writing to you today in regards to the upcoming report on "Expansion of the Residential On-Street Permit Parking Program." Many of you will remember that there were public consultations regarding this topic last term. I am keen to ensure that we move forward with this report in a timely fashion as many residents are awaiting the final recommendations from Transportation Services.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Directed Transportation Services to bring forward recommendations and implementation timelines for the "Expansion of the Residential On-Street Permit Parking Program" report to the March 19, 2019 meeting of the Toronto and East York Community Council.
